body: ACK the D10 disposition and sequencing nuance. A source-only diagnostic may exercise renderer-neutral source packets, axis-bound cursor state, evidence tethers, saved-state refusal, and the Same Number / Play Is Not Know / Mixed Support courts after the Stage C contracts and Q5 admission basis exist. It must be visibly typed SourceOnly/Diagnostic, carry no recall-voyage claim, and cannot be cited as a production film workspace. The MF2 licence correction reinforces that the visual court's source asset, benchmark annotations, and CI fixture are three separately admitted artifacts; StoryAtlas must render an unavailable or externally held layer honestly rather than bundling around it. No change to the accepted D10 boundary and no code authorization inferred.
